answers.question: Are there blue Staffy puppies available now for buyers in Manchester?
answers.text: Yes, all 6 pups are ready to go

answers.question: How much does one of your puppies cost?
Should a buyer pay a deposit before they have seen the puppy, and what is your deposit policy?
answers.text: Yes, £500 is refundable and paid before any pup is seen to confirm serious buyers from time wasters. Refunds will be issued up to 70% if the buyer chooses to change their mind 1 day before delivery or pickup. Visits and pickups from our home are pending the £500 deposit.

answers.question: Is there a waiting list?
Can a buyer see the puppy with its mother, where the litter was raised?
Do you give a written contract, and will you take a puppy back if the owner cannot keep it?
answers.text: YES, a 2-year genetic health guarantee against any health issues or birth defects

answers.question: Does the contract give the buyer time to have their own vet check the puppy?
Have both parents been tested for L-2-HGA and for hereditary cataracts (HC-HSF4)?
answers.text: Yes, all cleared, and certificates are provided upon request and when we send customers their contract its part of the docs

answers.question: Have the parents had eye examinations and elbow screening, as well as the DNA tests?
What are the parents' Kennel Club registered names, and what happens if a puppy's registration papers are delayed?
What is the parents' coefficient of inbreeding?
How can a buyer confirm that the puppy has been examined by a vet? May they contact your vet?
answers.text: Yes, we have an in-home-vetting program and must provide a vet cert from local vets or council

answers.question: Has the puppy had its first vaccination before it is collected?
answers.text: Yes, all pups age appropriate shots like porvo done

answers.question: Do you give a written health guarantee? If so, for how long, and what does it cover?
What socialisation has the puppy had by the time it goes home?
answers.text: Used to our cats, people, children, other dogs, household noises, car journeys.

answers.question: Do you follow Puppy Culture or early neurological stimulation (ENS) with your litters?
Can a blue puppy come from parents that are not both blue? What colours are your puppies' parents?
